newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish First NFI Fund '96 net loss at PLN 46.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish First NFI Fund '96 net loss at PLN 46.5 mln.

text.p: Poland's First National Investment Fund (NFI) had a 46.5 million zloty net loss last year, compared with a 2.1 million zloty shortfall in 1995, the fund said in an issue prospectus on Monday.
The First NFI fund plans, within eight to 10 years, to increase the amount of higher risk, non-public, firms in its investment portfolio to between 73 and 75 percent.
Minority stakes will make up some 15 to 17 percent of the portfolio with the remaining 10 percent invested in firms which were listed on the bourse.
Presently some 60 percent of the First NFI's investment portfolio is comprised of strategic 33-percent stakes and 40 percent of minority stakes.
The First NFI fund is one of 15 funds which manage more than 500 companies in Poland's mass privatisation programme.
